title: Validated mandatory procedure scratchpad append
description: A nonce-scoped scratchpad entry required before every original or revised Procedure state transition. The server supplies the nonce, current state keyword, active projection revision, sequence number and timestamp; the caller supplies only a structured note. The declared evidence type, observations, consequences and readiness must remain distinguishable. This schema verifies structure and documentation, not the objective truth of the claims.

note.description: Structured stage-specific record. Content must refer to work performed or an explicit limitation in the currently active procedure projection; a generic acknowledgement or filler is insufficient.

category.description: Classification of the purpose of the note. This controls the interpretation of the recorded observation but does not itself establish factual validity.

summary.description: Specific observation, finding, or decision relevant to the current procedure stage. Include concrete referents, affected state or artifact, and actual result rather than merely saying that work is complete.

evidence_status.description: Whether the supporting record cited here is directly checked, currently unverified, or legitimately inapplicable (e.g. initial intent parsing). An assertion of 'verified' requires at least one source reference.

evidence.description: Source-linked facts that support the summary. Entries must identify a concrete origin, locator and its particular finding; distinguish a tool result or source text from inference. Empty only when evidence is not verified or not applicable.

kind.description: Class of the supporting information. A simulation, calculation or source interpretation should not be labeled as a direct measurement.

reference.description: Traceable citation, path, tool receipt, measurement identifier, or explicit conversation reference rather than a generic word like 'source'.

finding.description: What the specific source actually supports, with limitations when relevant; avoid implying that mere existence of a reference proves causality.

assessment.description: Reasoned implication for the current procedure, including why the observation matters to an expected result, decision, requirement, error, risk, or next state.

next_action.description: Specific immediate next operation, verification or handoff, expressed as an executable or inspectable action. For a final stage this may state how to verify/review the completed record.

readiness.description: Stage-readiness declaration. 'ready' allows transition if all other validation passes; 'blocked' records a finding but prevents advancement until a later valid 'ready' note is appended for this same revision.

unresolved.description: Concrete unknowns or blockers. 'blocked' requires at least one unresolved item; 'ready' may still retain nonblocking open questions.

limitation.description: Required when evidence is 'unverified'. Explain exactly what could not yet be established and what evidence would resolve it.
